fusions.name: Whisking Strands
fusions.desc: Lashes a cone 2 tiles ahead with whipping strands of mane, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Plaited Lasso
fusions.desc: Casts a braided lasso at an enemy up to 6 tiles away and runs it down, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full range, and slowing it by 30% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Felted Mane
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of matted mane that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tangling Tail
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying any affliction, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
